Update: p(phone_nico/talia, mug_marisol, charger_marisol) > 0.70 at counter_k1 when resident_3 present.", "fork": {"beliefs": "BELIEFS: 
1. Kitchen Counter (counter_k1) is the primary transient hub for personal electronics (phones, chargers) and drinkware (mugs, water bottles) when resident_3 is present. Evidence: d10 06:57 look revealed phone_nico, phone_talia, charger_marisol, mug_marisol, water_bottle_nico all present simultaneously. Previous low probabilities for these items were incorrect; they are highly likely here during morning activity.

3. Cupboard (cupboard_k1) is not a reliable storage for keys_nico when resident_3 is in kitchen. Evidence: d10 06:55 cupboard_k1 empty despite resident_3 presence. Keys likely ON_PERSON or at entry. 
4. Nightstand (nightstand_b1) is not stable for glasses_marisol when resident_1 is absent. Evidence: d10 06:57 nightstand_b1 empty. Glasses likely ON_PERSON or moved. 
5. Bedroom floors/beds (bedroom_floor_b3, bed_b3) are not storage spots for personal gear. Evidence: d10 looks showed empty despite resident_3 presence. Items move to desks or ON_PERSON. 
6. Resident presence dictates location: Common areas (kitchen) dominate daytime activity. Personal items cluster in high-traffic receptacles (counter) rather than fixed storage (cupboard/nightstand) when residents are active. 
7. Talia carries nothing when in bedroom_2; gear is in receptacles. Nico carries nothing when in bedroom_3; phone likely in desk/counter. Marisol carries phone_marisol (p>0.80).", "why": "The d10 06:57 look at counter_k1 revealed a cluster of personal items (phones, mugs, chargers) that my previous beliefs underestimated. Updating beliefs to reflect this high-probability location for these specific items when resident_3 is present will improve forecast accuracy."}}
